performance.native_boundary: Release Swift/MLX GPU, serial flow/Mimi, includes per-request voice conditioning, text planning and first callback; excludes model/voice file loading.
performance.upstream_boundary: Official unmodified bench Synth::stream, 4 CPU threads, Accelerate/KleidiAI feature build, parallel flow/Mimi workers, cached voice prefix; excludes model loading and voice conditioning. M3 Max lacks SME2.
performance.comparable_format: Original safetensors F32 compute compared separately from upstream Q8.
performance.interpretation: Native Metal is about 25x real time, with 7-9ms median first audio. Upstream F32 and Q8 remain faster in total generation. These are measured paths with different scheduling/voice-cache boundaries, not a matched-kernel speed claim.
